title: Lighthouse Yoga Center
specs: Unlimited Zoom, in-person, and on-demand yoga classes
Family Membership valid for 2 people of same household
blurb: Guests can join unlimited yoga classes via Zoom, in-person, or on-demand video replays. Memberships include discounts on workshops, series, and retail. Occasional class cards and family memberships are also available.
extraNote: Membership auto-renews at $108/month · To cancel, email at least a week prior to the end of the intro month · Cancel with 15 days notice for full and family memberships · Washington DC charges 6% sales tax on yoga classes
